    /* CSS PART 1 OF 4 */

/* =========================================
   JOSH BROOKS CONSTRUCTION & RENOVATION
   Original design direction:
   Modern craftsmanship / Colorado residential
   Palette: charcoal, warm stone, copper
   ========================================= */

/* 1. DESIGN TOKENS */

:root {
  /* Core palette */
  --color-ink: #202a2e;
  --color-ink-soft: #344147;
  --color-charcoal: #172125;
  --color-stone: #f4f2ed;
  --color-paper: #fbfaf7;
  --color-white: #ffffff;
  --color-muted: #737d7e;
  --color-line: #deded7;

  /* Accent */
  --color-accent: #bd7449;
  --color-accent-dark: #985536;
  --color-accent-light: #e7c4a9;

  /* Semantic colors */
  --color-success: #426b56;
  --color-error: #a43e35;
  --color-focus: #d68c52;

  /* Typography */
  --font-display: "Georgia", "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-body: "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;

  --text-xs: 0.75rem;
  --text-sm: 0.875rem;
  --text-base: 1rem;
  --text-lg: 1.125rem;
  --text-xl: 1.35rem;
  --text-2xl: 1.75rem;
  --text-3xl: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
  --text-4xl: clamp(2.7rem, 5.5vw, 5rem);
  --text-hero: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6.6rem);

  --line-tight: 1.05;
  --line-heading: 1.15;
  --line-body: 1.7;

  /* Spacing */
  --space-1: 0.375rem;
  --space-2: 0.625rem;
  --space-3: 0.875rem;
  --space-4: 1rem;
  --space-5: 1.5rem;
  --space-6: 2rem;
  --space-7: 3rem;
  --space-8: 4rem;
  --space-9: 5rem;
  --space-10: 7rem;
  --space-11: 9rem;

  /* Layout */
  --container: 1240px;
  --container-wide: 1440px;
  --container-narrow: 800px;
  --page-gutter: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 5rem);

  /* Borders and corners */
  --border-subtle: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  --radius-sm: 3px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 14px;
  --radius-pill: 999px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-soft: 0 8px 28px rgba(25, 35, 38, 0.07);
  --shadow-medium: 0 18px 48px rgba(25, 35, 38, 0.12);

  /* Motion */
  --transition-fast: 180ms ease;
  --transition-normal: 300ms ease;
  --transition-slow: 500ms ease;
}


/* 2. RESET AND GLOBAL FOUNDATIONS */

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scroll-padding-top: 6rem;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  background: var(--color-paper);
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  line-height: var(--line-body);
  font-weight: 400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body,
button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}

img,
picture,
video,
svg {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
}

img {
  height: auto;
}

button,
input,
select,
textarea {
  font-size: inherit;
}

button,
a {
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

ul,
ol {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

li {
  list-style: none;
}

p {
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
}

figure {
  margin: 0;
}

fieldset {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: var(--color-white);
}


/* 3. ACCESSIBILITY FOUNDATIONS */

:focus {
  outline: none;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 9999;
  top: -100px;
  left: 1rem;
  padding: 0.85rem 1.25rem;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 1rem;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}


/* 4. TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM */

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: var(--line-heading);
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

h1 {
  font-size: var(--text-hero);
  line-height: var(--line-tight);
  letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}

h2 {
  font-size: var(--text-4xl);
}

h3 {
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
}

h4 {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
}

h5,
h6 {
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
}

p {
  color: inherit;
}

.text-lead {
  max-width: 660px;
  font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.25rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--color-muted);
}

.text-small {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.text-uppercase {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
}

.eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.17em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  width: 30px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-accent);
}

.heading-accent {
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
}

.section-intro {
  max-width: 650px;
}

.section-intro p {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  line-height: 1.8;
}


/* 5. PAGE GRID AND CONTAINERS */

.container {
  width: min(
    var(--container),
    calc(100% - (var(--page-gutter) * 2))
  );
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.container-wide {
  width: min(
    var(--container-wide),
    calc(100% - (var(--page-gutter) * 2))
  );
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.container-narrow {
  width: min(
    var(--container-narrow),
    calc(100% - (var(--page-gutter) * 2))
  );
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.page-wrapper {
  width: 100%;
  overflow: clip;
}

.section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 8rem);
}

.section-tight {
  padding-block: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem);
}

.section-dark {
  background: var(--color-charcoal);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.section-dark h2,
.section-dark h3,
.section-dark h4 {
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.section-dark .section-intro p {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

.section-stone {
  background: var(--color-stone);
}

.section-paper {
  background: var(--color-paper);
}


/* 6. SHARED GRID FOUNDATIONS */

.grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-6);
}

.grid-2 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.grid-3 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.grid-4 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.split-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
}

.split-layout-wide {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
}

.split-layout-reverse {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.85fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
}

.flex {
  display: flex;
}

.flex-between {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.flex-center {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.flex-wrap {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.align-start {
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.align-center {
  align-items: center;
}

.gap-sm {
  gap: var(--space-3);
}

.gap-md {
  gap: var(--space-5);
}

.gap-lg {
  gap: var(--space-7);
}


/* 7. SHARED SPACING AND WIDTH UTILITIES */

.mx-auto {
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.text-left {
  text-align: left;
}

.max-width-sm {
  max-width: 480px;
}

.max-width-md {
  max-width: 650px;
}

.max-width-lg {
  max-width: 850px;
}

.full-width {
  width: 100%;
}

.relative {
  position: relative;
}

.overflow-hidden {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}


/* 8. RESPONSIVE GRID FOUNDATIONS */

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  :root {
    --space-10: 5rem;
    --space-11: 6rem;
  }

  .grid-4 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .split-layout,
  .split-layout-wide,
  .split-layout-reverse {
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  :root {
    --page-gutter: 1.25rem;
    --space-7: 2.5rem;
    --space-8: 3rem;
    --space-9: 3.75rem;
    --space-10: 4rem;
    --space-11: 4.5rem;
  }

  html {
    scroll-padding-top: 5rem;
  }

  .section {
    padding-block: 4rem;
  }

  .section-tight {
    padding-block: 3rem;
  }

  .grid-2,
  .grid-3,
  .grid-4,
  .split-layout,
  .split-layout-wide,
  .split-layout-reverse {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }

  .split-layout {
    gap: 2rem;
  }

  .flex-between {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .text-center-mobile {
    text-align: center;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  :root {
    --page-gutter: 1rem;
  }

  h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 13vw, 3.8rem);
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 10vw, 2.7rem);
  }

  .text-lead {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
}

    /* CSS PART 2 OF 4 */

/* =========================================
   HEADER, NAVIGATION, HERO & PRIMARY ACTION
   Josh Brooks Construction & Renovation Inc.
   ========================================= */

/* 1. SITE HEADER */

.site-header {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1000;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--color-paper);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(32, 42, 46, 0.12);
}

.header-inner {
  width: min(
    var(--container-wide),
    calc(100% - (var(--page-gutter) * 2))
  );
  min-height: 94px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.site-brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  min-width: 190px;
  color: var(--color-ink);
}

.site-brand img {
  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;
  object-fit: contain;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.brand-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
}

.brand-name {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.brand-descriptor {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}


/* 2. MAIN NAVIGATION */

.main-navigation {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
}

.main-navigation ul {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.75rem);
}

.main-navigation a {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  color: var(--color-ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.main-navigation a::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 5px;
  left: 0;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-accent);
  content: "";
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.main-navigation a:hover,
.main-navigation a:focus-visible {
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
}

.main-navigation a:hover::after,
.main-navigation a:focus-visible::after,
.main-navigation a[aria-current="page"]::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}


/* 3. HEADER CONTACT DETAILS */

.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.header-phone {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.header-phone-label {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.header-phone a {
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.header-phone a:hover {
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
}


/* 4. BUTTON SYSTEM */

.button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 52px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.9rem 1.6rem;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.025em;
  line-height: 1.2;
  text-align: center;
  transition:
    background var(--transition-fast),
    color var(--transition-fast),
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    transform var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}

.button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.button-primary {
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: var(--color-white);
  border-color: var(--color-accent);
}

.button-primary:hover {
  background: var(--color-accent-dark);
  border-color: var(--color-accent-dark);
  color: var(--color-white);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.button-dark {
  background: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-white);
  border-color: var(--color-ink);
}

.button-dark:hover {
  background: var(--color-charcoal);
  border-color: var(--color-charcoal);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.button-outline {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-ink);
  border-color: rgba(32, 42, 46, 0.35);
}

.button-outline:hover {
  background: var(--color-ink);
  border-color: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.button-light {
  background: var(--color-white);
  color: var(--color-ink);
  border-color: var(--color-white);
}

.button-light:hover {
  background: var(--color-stone);
  border-color: var(--color-stone);
}

.button-outline-light {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-white);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
}

.button-outline-light:hover {
  background: var(--color-white);
  color: var(--color-ink);
}

.button-block {
  width: 100%;
}


/* 5. MOBILE NAVIGATION CONTROL */

.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.menu-toggle span {
  display: block;
  width: 19px;
  height: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  transition:
    transform var(--transition-fast),
    opacity var(--transition-fast);
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:first-child {
  transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}

.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:last-child {
  transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
}


/* 6. HERO SECTION */

.hero {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: min(760px, calc(100svh - 94px));
  padding-block: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 8.5rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--color-charcoal);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.hero-background {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}

.hero-background img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center 48%;
}

.hero-background::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.94) 0%,
      rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.82) 43%,
      rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.34) 100%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      0deg,
      rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.48),
      transparent 50%
    );
  content: "";
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(
    var(--container),
    calc(100% - (var(--page-gutter) * 2))
  );
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.hero-content {
  max-width: 800px;
}

.hero .eyebrow {
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
}

.hero .eyebrow::before {
  background: var(--color-accent-light);
}

.hero h1 {
  max-width: 850px;
  margin-bottom: 1.7rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.hero h1 em {
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
  font-style: normal;
}

.hero-description {
  max-width: 590px;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 2rem;
}

.hero .button-primary {
  min-height: 58px;
  padding-inline: 2rem;
}

.hero .button-outline-light {
  min-height: 58px;
  padding-inline: 2rem;
}


/* 7. HERO CREDENTIAL STRIP */

.hero-credentials {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem 2rem;
  margin-top: 3.5rem;
  padding-top: 1.6rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
}

.hero-credential {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.credential-mark {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 27px;
  height: 27px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-accent-light);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
}


/* 8. HERO IMAGE DETAIL */

.hero-image-caption {
  position: absolute;
  right: var(--page-gutter);
  bottom: 2rem;
  z-index: 2;
  max-width: 260px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--color-accent-light);
  background: rgba(23, 33, 37, 0.82);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}


/* 9. QUICK CONTACT BAR */

.quick-contact {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.quick-contact-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  width: min(
    var(--container),
    calc(100% - (var(--page-gutter) * 2))
  );
  min-height: 76px;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.quick-contact-copy {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.quick-contact-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.quick-contact-links a {
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: transparent;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
  transition: text-decoration-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.quick-contact-links a:hover {
  text-decoration-color: currentColor;
}


/* 10. RESPONSIVE HEADER AND NAVIGATION */

@media (max-width: 1150px) {
  .header-inner {
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .main-navigation ul {
    gap: 0.9rem;
  }

  .main-navigation a {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }

  .header-phone {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .header-inner {
    min-height: 78px;
  }

  .site-brand img {
    width: 54px;
    height: 54px;
  }

  .menu-toggle {
    display: flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .main-navigation {
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    right: 0;
    left: 0;
    display: none;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem var(--page-gutter) 1.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line);
    background: var(--color-paper);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium);
  }

  .main-navigation.is-open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .main-navigation ul {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .main-navigation li {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  }

  .main-navigation a {
    display: flex;
    min-height: 49px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .main-navigation a::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .header-actions {
    width: 100%;
    padding-top: 1rem;
  }

  .header-actions .button {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .hero {
    min-height: 680px;
    min-height: min(760px, calc(100svh - 78px));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .header-inner {
    min-height: 72px;
  }

  .site-brand {
    min-width: 0;
    gap: 0.65rem;
  }

  .site-brand img {
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
  }

  .brand-name {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }

  .brand-descriptor {
    font-size: 0.53rem;
  }

  .hero {
    min-height: auto;
    padding-block: 5rem 4rem;
  }

  .hero-background img {
    object-position: 58% center;
  }

  .hero-background::after {
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.9),
        rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.66)
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        rgba(19, 29, 32, 0.55),
        transparent
      );
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 12vw, 4.2rem);
  }

  .hero-description {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  .hero-actions .button {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-credentials {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    margin-top: 2.5rem;
  }

  .hero-image-caption {
    display: none;
  }

  .quick-contact-inner {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding-block: 1.25rem;
  }

  .quick-contact-links {
    gap: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .brand-name {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  .brand-descriptor {
    letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  }

  .menu-toggle {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
  }
}

    /* CSS PART 3 OF 4 */

/* =========================================
   CONTENT SECTIONS, PROJECT GALLERY,
   CONTACT FORM AND FOOTER
   ========================================= */


/* 1. INTRODUCTION / COMPANY APPROACH */

.intro-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  background: var(--color-paper);
}

.intro-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
}

.intro-heading {
  max-width: 570px;
}

.intro-heading h2 {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.intro-copy {
  max-width: 590px;
}

.intro-copy p {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.intro-copy p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.intro-note {
  margin-top: 1.75rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-accent);
  background: var(--color-stone);
  color: var(--color-ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}


/* 2. EXPERIENCE AND CREDENTIALS */

.credentials-section {
  padding-block: 2.5rem;
  background: var(--color-ink);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.credentials-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 2rem;
}

.credential-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-inline: 1.5rem;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

.credential-item:first-child {
  padding-left: 0;
}

.credential-item:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}

.credential-number {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.credential-description {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.credential-description strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}


/* 3. SERVICES SECTION */

.services-section {
  padding-block: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  background: var(--color-stone);
}

.services-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
}

.services-heading .section-intro {
  max-width: 670px;
}

.services-heading h2 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.services-heading p {
  max-width: 570px;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
}

.services-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line);
}

.service-item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  min-height: 155px;
  padding: 2rem 2rem 2rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line);
}

.service-item:nth-child(odd) {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--color-line);
}

.service-item:nth-child(even) {
  padding-left: 2rem;
}

.service-index {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.service-content h3 {
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.service-content p {
  max-width: 390px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.91rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.service-item:hover .service-content h3 {
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
}


/* 4. FEATURED PROJECTS / GALLERY */

.projects-section {
  padding-block: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  background: var(--color-paper);
}

.projects-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.projects-heading h2 {
  max-width: 650px;
}

.projects-heading p {
  max-width: 420px;
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
}

.project-feature {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.project-image {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--color-stone);
}

.project-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 300px;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
}

.project-image:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.035);
}

.project-feature .project-image img {
  min-height: 480px;
}

.project-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
  background: var(--color-stone);
}

.project-category {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.project-details h3 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.7rem);
}

.project-details p {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.project-gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.project-card {
  min-width: 0;
}

.project-card .project-image {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.project-card .project-image img {
  min-height: 0;
}

.project-card h3 {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.project-card p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}


/* 5. IMAGE BEFORE / AFTER COMPARISON */

.before-after {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.before-after-item {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.before-after-item img {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.image-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0.8rem;
  left: 0.8rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
  background: var(--color-charcoal);
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}


/* 6. PROCESS SECTION */

.process-section {
  padding-block: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  background: var(--color-charcoal);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.process-section h2 {
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.process-section .section-intro p {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
}

.process-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr;
  gap: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
}

.process-steps {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.process-step {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 65px 1fr;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding-block: 1.7rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.process-step-number {
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 2rem;
}

.process-step h3 {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
}

.process-step p {
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.process-note {
  align-self: start;
  padding: 2rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
}

.process-note h3 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
  font-size: 1.7rem;
}

.process-note p {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  font-size: 0.93rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.process-note p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}


/* 7. SERVICE AREA SECTION */

.service-area-section {
  padding-block: clamp(4.5rem, 8vw, 7rem);
  background: var(--color-stone);
}

.service-area-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
  gap: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.service-area-copy h2 {
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.service-area-copy p {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.service-area-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.service-area-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(32, 42, 46, 0.18);
  background: var(--color-paper);
  color: var(--color-ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.service-area-footnote {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}


/* 8. CONTACT SECTION */

.contact-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  background: var(--color-paper);
}

.contact-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr;
  gap: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
  align-items: start;
}

.contact-intro {
  position: sticky;
  top: 2rem;
}

.contact-intro h2 {
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.contact-intro > p {
  max-width: 440px;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.contact-methods {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 2.5rem;
}

.contact-method {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.contact-method-icon {
  display: flex;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--color-stone);
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
}

.contact-method-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.contact-method-content span {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.contact-method-content a {
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.contact-method-content a:hover {
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
}

.contact-form-wrap {
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  background: var(--color-white);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.contact-form-heading {
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.contact-form-heading h3 {
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  font-size: 2rem;
}

.contact-form-heading p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}


/* 9. FORM FIELDS */

.contact-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.form-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.form-field-full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.form-field label {
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.form-field label .required {
  color: var(--color-accent-dark);
}

.form-field input,
.form-field select,
.form-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 51px;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #d9dad5;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  outline: none;
  background: var(--color-paper);
  color: var(--color-ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transition:
    border-color var(--transition-fast),
    box-shadow var(--transition-fast),
    background var(--transition-fast);
}

.form-field input::placeholder,
.form-field textarea::placeholder {
  color: #929997;
}

.form-field textarea {
  min-height: 145px;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.form-field input:focus,
.form-field select:focus,
.form-field textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--color-accent);
  background: var(--color-white);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(189, 116, 73, 0.13);
}

.form-field input:focus-visible,
.form-field select:focus-visible,
.form-field textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.contact-form .button {
  min-height: 56px;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.form-disclaimer {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}


/* 10. FOOTER */

.site-footer {
  background: var(--color-charcoal);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.footer-main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 0.7fr 0.9fr;
  gap: 4rem;
  padding-block: 5rem;
}

.footer-brand {
  max-width: 370px;
}

.footer-brand .site-brand {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.footer-brand .brand-descriptor {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
}

.footer-brand p {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.footer-heading {
  margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.footer-links {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.footer-links a {
  width: fit-content;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.footer-links a:hover {
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
}

.footer-contact p {
  margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.68);
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.footer-contact a {
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  min-height: 75px;
  padding-block: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
}

.footer-bottom p {
  margin: 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.footer-license {
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}


/* 11. FINAL CONTACT CALLOUT */

.final-cta {
  padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.final-cta-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.final-cta h2 {
  max-width: 680px;
  color: var(--color-white);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.4rem);
}

.final-cta p {
  max-width: 570px;
  margin: 0.8rem 0 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.final-cta .button {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}


/* 12. RESPONSIVE CONTENT ADAPTATIONS */

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .intro-layout,
  .process-layout,
  .service-area-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }

  .contact-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.2fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }

  .footer-main {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 3rem;
  }

  .footer-brand {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .project-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.8fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .credentials-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .credential-item,
  .credential-item:first-child {
    padding: 0;
    border-right: 0;
  }

  .services-heading,
  .projects-heading {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .services-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .service-item,
  .service-item:nth-child(even),
  .service-item:nth-child(odd) {
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 1.5rem 0;
    border-right: 0;
  }

  .project-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .project-feature .project-image img {
    min-height: 300px;
    max-height: 430px;
  }

  .project-details {
    padding: 1.75rem;
  }

  .project-gallery {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem 1rem;
  }

  .contact-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;

    /* CSS PART 4 OF 4 */

/* =========================================
   FINAL RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR, ACCESSIBILITY
   AND CROSS-SECTION REFINEMENTS
   ========================================= */


/* 1. GLOBAL RESPONSIVE IMAGE BEHAVIOR */

img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-background,
.project-image,
.before-after-item {
  isolation: isolate;
}

.project-image img,
.before-after-item img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.project-image:focus-within {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}


/* 2. ACCESSIBLE INTERACTIVE STATES */

a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.button:focus-visible {
  outline-color: var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 5px;
}

.main-navigation a:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.menu-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.form-field input:focus-visible,
.form-field select:focus-visible,
.form-field textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}


/* 3. MOBILE NAVIGATION REFINEMENTS */

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .site-header {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1000;
  }

  .main-navigation {
    max-height: calc(100svh - 78px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }

  .main-navigation a {
    width: 100%;
    padding-block: 0.35rem;
  }

  .main-navigation li:last-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
  }

  .main-navigation .button {
    justify-content: center;
  }
}


/* 4. TABLET LAYOUT REFINEMENTS */

@media (min-width: 701px) and (max-width: 1000px) {
  .hero-content {
    max-width: 720px;
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5.2rem);
  }

  .services-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .project-gallery {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .project-gallery .project-card:last-child {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    max-width: 50%;
  }

  .contact-form-wrap {
    padding: 2rem;
  }
}


/* 5. SMALL SCREEN HERO REFINEMENTS */

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .hero {
    min-height: auto;
    min-height: calc(100svh - 72px);
    align-items: center;
  }

  .hero-inner {
    padding-block: 1rem;
  }

  .hero h1 {
    max-width: 520px;
    line-height: 1.03;
  }

  .hero-description {
    max-width: 470px;
  }

  .hero-credentials {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-credential {
    font-size: 0.69rem;
  }

  .hero .button {
    min-height: 54px;
  }

  .quick-contact {
    text-align: left;
  }
}


/* 6. VERY SMALL SCREEN ADAPTATIONS */

@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .header-inner {
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .brand-name {
    max-width: 180px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .brand-descriptor {
    font-size: 0.48rem;
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: 2.65rem;
  }

  .hero-credentials {
    gap: 0.8rem;
  }

  .credential-item {
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  .service-item {
    gap: 0.9rem;
  }

  .service-content h3 {
    font-size: 1.4rem;
  }

  .project-details {
    padding: 1.25rem;
  }

  .contact-form-wrap {
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  .button {
    padding-inline: 1.1rem;
  }
}


/* 7. LANDSCAPE MOBILE VIEWPORTS */

@media (max-height: 540px) and (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero {
    min-height: auto;
    padding-block: 3rem;
  }

  .hero-credentials {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
    padding-top: 1rem;
  }

  .main-navigation {
    max-height: calc(100svh - 65px);
  }
}


/* 8. LARGE SCREEN REFINEMENTS */

@media (min-width: 1450px) {
  .hero {
    min-height: 780px;
  }

  .hero-content {
    max-width: 900px;
  }

  .intro-layout {
    gap: 8rem;
  }

  .section {
    padding-block: 9rem;
  }
}


/* 9. TOUCHSCREEN USABILITY */

@media (hover: none) {
  .button:hover {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .project-image:hover img {
    transform: none;
  }

  .main-navigation a {
    min-height: 48px;
  }

  .quick-contact-links a {
    padding-block: 0.25rem;
  }
}


/* 10. MOTION AND ANIMATION PREFERENCES */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .project-card,
  .service-item,
  .contact-method {
    transition:
      background-color var(--transition-normal),
      border-color var(--transition-normal);
  }

  .project-card:hover {
    background: rgba(244, 242, 237, 0.55);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}


/* 11. FORM VALIDATION AND STATUS STATES */

.form-field input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown),
.form-field textarea:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown) {
  border-color: var(--color-error);
}

.form-field input:valid:not(:placeholder-shown),
.form-field textarea:valid:not(:placeholder-shown) {
  border-color: var(--color-success);
}

.form-error {
  color: var(--color-error);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.form-success {
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-success);
  background: #edf3ee;
  color: var(--color-success);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}


/* 12. CONTENT WRAPPING AND OVERFLOW PROTECTION */

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
p,
a,
label {
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

.contact-method-content a,
.footer-links a {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.grid > *,
.split-layout > *,
.project-gallery > *,
.contact-layout > * {
  min-width: 0;
}


/* 13. PRINT STYLES */

@media print {
  body {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #000000;
    font-size: 11pt;
  }

  .site-header,
  .menu-toggle,
  .hero-actions,
  .quick-contact,
  .final-cta,
  .contact-form-wrap {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero {
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 2rem 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #000000;
  }

  .hero-background {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero h1,
  .hero .eyebrow,
  .hero-description,
  .section-dark h2,
  .section-dark h3 {
    color: #000000;
  }

  .section,
  .intro-section,
  .services-section,
  .projects-section,
  .process-section,
  .contact-section {
    padding-block: 1.5rem;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #000000;
    break-inside: avoid;
  }

  .project-image img {
    max-height: 260px;
  }

  .site-footer {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #000000;
  }

  .footer-links a,
  .footer-contact a,
  .footer-brand p,
  .footer-bottom p {
    color: #000000;
  }

  a {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
}


/* 14. FINAL BRAND CONSISTENCY */

::selection {
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: #ffffff;
}

.eyebrow,
.project-category,
.footer-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}

.button,
.service-area-tag,
.image-label {
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.section-dark .eyebrow {
  color: var(--color-accent-light);
}

.section-dark .eyebrow::before {
  background: var(--color-accent-light);
}


/* 15. SECTION ANCHOR OFFSET */

#services,
#projects,
#process,
#service-areas,
#contact {
  scroll-margin-top: 6rem;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  #services,
  #projects,
  #process,
  #service-areas,
  #contact {
    scroll-margin-top: 5rem;
  }
}


/* END OF COMPLETE STYLESHEET */

<!-- Accessible navigation and interaction enhancements -->
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const menuButton = document.querySelector(
    '[aria-controls="primary-navigation"]'
  );

  const navigation = document.getElementById(
    'primary-navigation'
  );

  if (menuButton && navigation) {
    const closeMenu = () => {
      menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      navigation.classList.remove('is-open');
    };

    const openMenu = () => {
      menuButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      navigation.classList.add('is-open');
    };

    menuButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const expanded =
        menuButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';

      expanded ? closeMenu() : openMenu();
    });

    navigation.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link) => {
      link.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        closeMenu();
        menuButton.focus();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (
        menuButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' &&
        !navigation.contains(event.target) &&
        !menuButton.contains(event.target)
      ) {
        closeMenu();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (window.matchMedia('(min-width: 900px)').matches) {
        closeMenu();
      }
    });
  }

  // Respect reduced-motion preferences for in-page navigation.
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia(
    '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
  );

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((link) => {
    link.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const targetId = link.getAttribute('href');

      if (!targetId || targetId === '#') return;

      const target = document.querySelector(targetId);

      if (!target) return;

      event.preventDefault();

      target.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: reducedMotion.matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth',
        block: 'start'
      });

      if (!target.hasAttribute('tabindex')) {
        target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
      }

      target.focus({ preventScroll: true });

      if (history.replaceState) {
        history.replaceState(null, '', targetId);
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
